title: Master stays red for hours and every agent is blocked: retries for flaky desktop specs, fix radial-menu:168 in CI, and make the red an owned job
description: Fabio, 2026-09-19: 32 of the last 60 master runs failed, 11 in a row on one spec, agents push --no-verify around it and the next session inherits the mess. Three causes, three fixes: (1) playwright.desktop.config.js has no retries, so one flaky Electron boot (flow-packages:118 today, crop-resize-output:93 on the 18th) is a red master; (2) radial-menu.spec.js:168 fails only in CI, where zero models are installed and the empty-project fixture raises the No-models-installed modal that MPI-811 correctly gates Tab behind; (3) nothing makes a red anyone's job, and the pre-push hook itself offers --no-verify as a way to accept it. Cards cannot close green on a red run of their own commit.
